description: This monitoring collection describes a photovoltaic power station in Xinjiang and a wind farm in Hebei during 2020–2021. The Northwest Institute of Eco-Environment and Resources and Xinjiang University use drone imagery and X-ray fluorescence measurements to connect renewable-energy infrastructure with surrounding environmental conditions. The deposit includes photovoltaic boundaries, surface-model and vegetation-index products, wind-turbine coordinates, soil-element tables and nearby weather-station data extending from 1981 to 2019. ScienceDB lists CSV, KML and archived spatial files and assigns free reuse under CC BY 4.0. The two sites are specific examples, not a national renewable-energy inventory, and soil composition does not establish a causal infrastructure impact. These linked asset and environmental observations can support local exposure and land-interaction scenarios. No directly related catalogue entry was found.
name: A dataset of soil chemical elements for the typical photovoltaic power plant in Xinjiang and wind farm in Hebei during 2020 – 2021
